paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ta substitution method on the mechanical properties of Ni3(Si,Ti) intermetallic alloy

evidence.quote: In this study, Ta was added to an L1 2-type Ni3(Si,Ti) alloy at different levels and into different substitution sites, substituting for either Ni, Ti or Si.

process_steps.input_state: raw pure metals Ni, Si, Ti, Ta, B

evidence.quote: Button ingots with a diameter of 50 mm and a weight of approximately 130 g were prepared by arc melting the raw pure metals, Ni, Si, Ti, Ta and B, in an argon gas atmosphere using a non-consumable tungsten electrode on a copper hearth.
They were homogenized at 1323 K for 48 h in a vacuum and then furnace-cooled to room temperature.
